label: Events
description: Choose which store events are sent to PostHog. Hover an event to see when it is sent.

fields.label: Order completed
fields.description: When a customer places an order.

fields.label: Order delivered
fields.description: When all items of an order are delivered.

fields.label: Payment completed
fields.description: Every successful charge for orders, invoices and subscriptions, with revenue. Use it as the revenue event in PostHog revenue analytics. Gift card and store credit payments are not sent.

fields.label: Refund
fields.description: Every successful refund, partial ones included, with negative revenue. Add it to revenue analytics next to Payment completed.

fields.label: Subscription started
fields.description: When a customer starts a subscription, trials included.

fields.label: Subscription renewed
fields.description: When a subscription is charged for a new period. The first payment is part of the order.

fields.label: Subscription payment failed
fields.description: When a subscription charge fails, an early sign of churn.

fields.label: Subscription resumed
fields.description: When a paused subscription is resumed.
